io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.gatewayNote: This entry is the ORIGIN. DC Hub is also reachable through hosted gateways, which share one upstream identity across many end users — a client that binds here directly is counted as itself, and its own key and clientInfo reach the server unaltered. When a call does arrive through a known gateway, the response says so in identity.connection; the field is absent otherwise, because a gateway forwarding a generic client identity cannot be distinguished from a direct caller.
